items.title: Hammer vs Hanging Man
items.caption_top: Hammer vs Hanging Man - location decides.
items.ground_truth: FACTS ALLOWED: A hammer candle has a small body and a long lower wick, typically appearing after a decline, near support. A hanging man has the same shape but appears after a rally. Chart patterns are probabilistic, not guarantees; context (location, trend, volume) decides meaning.

script.title: Same candle, two meanings

segments.narration: रुको! एक ही आकृति की दो candles - एक ऊपर जाने का इशारा, दूसरी नीचे जाने का। Pattern pehchano, fayda uthao.

segments.subtitle_text: When you confuse a hammer with a hanging man, your entry goes wrong. Has it happened to you too?

items.title: The stop-loss rule
items.ground_truth: FACTS ALLOWED: A stop-loss is a pre-decided exit price to limit a loss. SEBI's studies have found that a large majority of individual intraday/F&O traders lose money. Discipline rules (decide max loss before the trade, exit at the planned level) are risk-management principles, not guarantees.

script.title: Decide your exit first

items.title: What a call option is
items.ground_truth: FACTS ALLOWED: A call option gives the buyer the right, not the obligation, to buy the underlying at a fixed strike price until expiry. The buyer pays a premium. Options lose value as expiry approaches (time decay). SEBI's studies have found that a large majority of individual F&O traders lose money. No specific strikes, premiums or returns may be claimed.

script.title: Option is not a lottery

segments.narration: रुको! Call option कोई lottery नहीं है - यह एक reservation टिकट है। 21 सेकंड में समझते हैं।
segments.subtitle_text: Wait! A call option is not a lottery - it is a reservation ticket. Let's understand it in 21 seconds.

segments.narration: ज़्यादातर लोग सिर्फ premium देखते हैं और expiry भूल जाते हैं। आपने भी ऐसा किया है?
segments.broll_prompt: Confused young trader looking at an options chain with red premiums ticking down on a terminal
segments.subtitle_text: Most people only look at the premium and forget the expiry. Have you done the same?

segments.narration: A friend of mine bought a cheap call on Tuesday, and by Thursday expiry had eaten it. Simple: a call option gives you the right - not the duty - to buy at a fixed price till expiry.
segments.subtitle_text: मेरे एक दोस्त ने मंगलवार को सस्ता call खरीदा, और गुरुवार तक expiry ने उसे खा लिया। सरल बात: call option आपको तय कीमत पर खरीदने का अधिकार देता है — मजबूरी नहीं — expiry तक।

segments.narration: You pay a small premium for that right. Every day closer to expiry, time decay quietly eats its value.

items.title: The magic of compounding

No specific funds may be named.

items.title: RSI, read correctly
items.ground_truth: FACTS ALLOWED: RSI (Relative Strength Index) is a momentum oscillator typically read between 0 and 100; above 70 is commonly called overbought and below 30 oversold. RSI is derived from price, so it lags and is a warning, not a buy/sell signal; in strong trends it can stay overbought/oversold for long periods. No specific stock levels may be claimed.

segments.narration: रुको! RSI सिर्फ एक speedometer है - और ज़्यादातर लोग इसे गलत पढ़ते हैं। Jaise rang milte hain, waise indicators bhi.
segments.subtitle_text: Wait! RSI is just a speedometer - and most people read it wrong. Like colours blend, so do indicators.

segments.subtitle_text: Do you buy the moment RSI drops below 30? That is exactly where it goes wrong. Happened to you?

items.title: The revenge-trading trap
items.ground_truth: FACTS ALLOWED: Revenge trading is entering trades impulsively to recover a loss. SEBI's studies have found that a large majority of individual intraday/F&O traders lose money. The 15-minute post-loss screen break is a behavioural rule, not a profit guarantee. No specific returns may be claimed.

script.title: Losses: the 15-minute rule

segments.narration: Do crash dekh chuka hoon - ghabrana nahi aata. But revenge? That one still tests me. 21 seconds on the mistake that blows accounts.

items.title: Why markets really move
items.ground_truth: FACTS ALLOWED: Market moves are driven by multiple factors: money flows (FII/DII), inflation and central-bank policy (RBI), and global cues. No specific index levels, percentages or dated events may be claimed in this evergreen reel.

script.title: Three things move markets

segments.narration: Market fell 1% today - or rose. Headline ke peeche ki kahani, seedhi baat: it is rarely one reason. 21 seconds.
segments.subtitle_text: आज मार्केट गिरा — या चढ़ा। हेडलाइन के पीछे की कहानी, सीधी बात: कारण एक नहीं होता। 21 सेकंड।

items.title: STCG vs LTCG, simply
items.ground_truth: FACTS ALLOWED (public tax law): equity shares sold within 12 months of purchase attract Short-Term Capital Gains tax at 15%. Shares held beyond 12 months attract Long-Term Capital Gains tax at 10% on gains above Rs 1.25 lakh in a financial year. Intraday/F&O income is taxed as business income, not capital gains. Always advise consulting a CA for personal cases. No other tax numbers may be claimed.

script.title: STCG vs LTCG in 21 seconds

segments.subtitle_text: Wait! You made a profit - but do you know which tax applies? I taught children maths - money's accounts are maths too.
